## Status Authority

This page is an evergreen map, not a schedule or progress meter. Live scope,
ownership, dependencies, and delivery state reside in the
[GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues) and
[pull requests](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/pulls). Protected
merge history is the authority for delivered changes. Dates, percentages, and
promises are intentionally omitted because a hand-maintained forecast cannot
establish readiness.

The repository's content-review process is documented in
[`content-development/`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/tree/main/content-development):

- [Rigor Guide](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/content-development/RIGOR_GUIDE.md)
- [Review Protocol](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/content-development/REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md)
- [Development plans](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/tree/main/content-development/plans)
- [Findings Index](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/content-development/FINDINGS_INDEX.md)

## State Contract

| State | Meaning | What it does not mean |
|---|---|---|
| **Available** | A linked page, source, or program exists and can be inspected. | Peer reviewed, experimentally validated, or suitable for a decision. |
| **Validated** | A specific claim names its validation evidence, revision, population or model, and limits. | The whole page or neighboring claims inherit that result. |
| **Experimental** | Work is available for exploration but remains under qualification. | Stable API, cross-engine parity, human validation, or production readiness. |
| **Planned** | A tracking issue or explicit proposal exists, but the deliverable is not available. | Active work, a promised date, or guaranteed delivery. |
| **Deprecated** | Material remains only for compatibility or historical reference. | Recommended use. |
| **Opinion** | Editorial interpretation, priorities, or hypotheses. | Empirical evidence or organizational commitment. |

Status is claim-specific. A readable book can be **Available** while some of its
claims remain **Experimental**. A software engine can be **Extended** in its own
support contract without making every analysis workflow validated.

## Public Content Workstreams

The site-wide scientific trust review is tracked by
[#4021](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4021). Its child
issues partition the rendered site without treating publication as review:

- [Physics of Golf audit #4054](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4054)
- [Geometry of Motion audit #4055](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4055)
- [Tangent-series audit #4056](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4056)
- [Critique-surface audit #4057](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4057)
- [Core-article audit #4058](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4058)
- [Applied-article audit #4059](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4059)
- [Model and repository audit #4060](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4060)
- [Resource and learning-path audit #4061](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4061)
- [Book audit #4062](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4062)
- [Site-level trust-surface audit #4063](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4063)

An open child issue means the corresponding review gate is not protected-closed.
The generated [Scientific Claim-Audit Inventory](../reports/scientific-claim-audit.html)
is the route-level status report; an inventory record is not itself scientific
evidence.

## Reading and Contribution Surfaces

- **Available:** [Article Index](../resources/articles.html),
  [The Physics of Golf](../articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/quarto/index.html),
  [The Geometry of Motion](../articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto/index.html),
  and the [book series](../books/index.html). Availability says only that the
  reader-facing material exists.
- **Experimental:** [Tangent-Space Series](tangent-hyperplanes.html) and
  [Daydreams & Doodles](daydreams-doodles.html), subject to their local scope notes.
- **Planned:** [Book Reviews](book-reviews.html); no review text is currently
  represented as delivered.
- **Available submission channels:** [Collaborate](collaborate.html) and
  [Contact](contact.html), without an acceptance or response-time promise.

## UpstreamDrift Software Boundary

[UpstreamDrift](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift) is the runtime
and computational repository. This roadmap does not duplicate its live backlog.
The capability statement reviewed here is pinned to protected UpstreamDrift
commit [`8cc236c6879e7535bb6bd15aecbe3396fb6dbb36`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/tree/8cc236c6879e7535bb6bd15aecbe3396fb6dbb36):

- **Supported:** MuJoCo, exercised by required pull-request CI.
- **Extended:** Drake and Pinocchio, exercised by scheduled or targeted validation.
- **Experimental:** OpenSim and MyoSuite, outside the required release gate.

See the pinned
[engine support contract](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/8cc236c6879e7535bb6bd15aecbe3396fb6dbb36/docs/engines/support_tiers.md)
and [getting-started guide](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/8cc236c6879e7535bb6bd15aecbe3396fb6dbb36/docs/user_guide/getting_started.md).
A support tier is a software-test boundary, not a statement of biomechanical
validity or cross-engine numerical equivalence.

## How to Choose Work

1. Check the relevant issue and its dependencies.
2. Verify that no active lease or pull request already owns the same files.
3. State the evidence and falsifier before strengthening a public claim.
4. Change canonical sources test-first and use an ordinary protected pull request.
5. Treat the work as delivered only after protected merge and exact-main verification.

For corrections, open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/new).
For private questions, use the [Contact page](contact.html).

*Authority snapshot reviewed: 2026-08-29. Follow the linked repositories for live state.*
